title: The credits after a win
description: The credits fade in on the desert. The Spelunker rides in on a camel, followed by two cavemen carrying the golden head, the credits music starts and the desert scrolls past: SPELUNKY, then A GAME BY DEREK YU, then PLATFORM ENGINE MARTIN PIECYK, with the sound effects and the screen scaling code.
